addressing: every `at` below is [start,end) into THIS source; containment is computed from those numbers, never declared

reader: makeRelationReader — the POSITIONAL English reader: an end's role is found by its position in the clause, not by case-marking on the word. English word order carries meaning and this reading uses it.

grainScope.domain: Structure — these observations are about how the material is arranged, not about what exists (Existence) or how it is being read (Interpretation)

Ground.is: a state, a manner, a co-presence — a relation with no discrete act in it
Ground.inEnglishHere: the label is a preposition ('burning WITH curiosity', 'seen a rabbit WITH a waistcoat-pocket'). The ends are not two actors; they are a figure and the ground it sits in.

Figure.is: a discrete act binding two discrete ends
Figure.inEnglishHere: the label is a finite verb or participle. end1 is what English grammar would call the subject, end2 the complement — and that mapping is TRUE OF THIS READER AND THIS LANGUAGE ONLY, which is why it is written here once and nowhere else.

Pattern.is: the recurring form across many links
Pattern.inEnglishHere: NOT PRODUCED BY THIS READING. Nothing here folds repeated links into a network; a Pattern-grain observation would have to be earned across the whole book, and this reading is scoped to one chapter.

distinction.is: a distinction drawn between two ends rather than a relation asserted between them
distinction.inEnglishHere: the label is a coordinator ('no pictures OR conversations'). Relate and Differentiate are different modes of the cube, so this is not a weaker CON — it is a different act.

grainScope.unsettled: an observation whose label does not settle in the received POS prior carries `grain_gap` and NO grain. It is kept in full. A missing prior produces a typed gap, never a guessed grain.

priors.name: earned verb vocabulary
priors.scope: a token is nominated as a verb only after following a recurring surface; minSurfaces 1, declared

priors.name: received verb widening
priors.giver: Universal Dependencies — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UniversalDependencies/UD_English-EWT/master/en_ewt-ud-train.conllu (train split), human-annotated gold treebank, native/priors/pos-eng.json
priors.scope: every form the received prior attests as (VERB+AUX)-dominant at minShare 0.5 joins the vocabulary as an ADDITION — participles, copulas and modals the recurrence gate can never earn on capitalisation-starved prose (2026-09-12, the two dominant GFP miss-themes); never removes an earned form, and Field connectors stay out (ADP-dominant)

priors.name: POS refusal gate
priors.giver: Universal Dependencies — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UniversalDependencies/UD_English-EWT/master/en_ewt-ud-train.conllu (train split), human-annotated gold treebank, native/priors/pos-eng.json
priors.scope: wordclass.js dominantClass at minShare 0.5 — REFUSES a relation whose connector settles as a non-verb; never confirms one (P56: settled means refusable, never confirmable)

priors.name: inherited subject
priors.scope: a nested clause with no subject of its own is read under the matrix subject that controls it

priors.name: script coverage per sentence
priors.scope: READING-SPEC S92 — tags each sentence cased/caseless so a mixed English+Mandarin document is readable per segment; this chapter is 100% cased

priors.name: case-marking prior
priors.scope: DELIBERATELY OMITTED. This is the positional reader, not makeCaseMarkedRelationReader. Case-marking is another language's prior, not a missing feature of this one.
